page.overview:
Who is Shadow Lady?

Shadow Lady wears the same clothes as her original counterpart, but her clothes are now dark blue with neon golden details. Her alternate color is pink with neon green details, but if you manage to view her ending with the alternate color, the green details somehow change into gold ones.

Also, you can see flashes of her face lit up when she uses the Plasma Barrier move.

Chun-Li's ending in Marvel vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes hinted that M. Bison intended to alter her in the same way as Charlie Nash until Shadow stepped in to stop Bison with a flurry of Flash Kicks. Shadow Lady's ending in the game also showed a similar fate befalling fellow Capcom hero Jin Saotome after he just barely survives a losing fight with Bison, leaving him on the brink of death.

Shadow Lady's "Capcom Fighters Network" profile describes Chun-Li being captured by M. Bison and altered the same way that Nash was turned into Shadow. However, she was not enhanced with Psycho Power like Shadow was, only gaining mechanical parts that enhance her mobility and power due to his interference. Shortly after her remodeling, she ran away from Shadaloo while slowly regaining her memory, joining Shadow to fight against evil.
